Heuristic baseline for dynamic link prediction

Source: R/temporal-graph.R
dynamic_link_baseline.Rd

Scores the links of snapshot k with a heuristic computed from snapshots 1, ..., k - 1 only: the number of earlier interactions between the pair ("history") or the product of earlier degrees ("preferential"), with the same negative sampling as train_dynamic_link_model().

Usage

dynamic_link_baseline(
  snapshots,
  steps,
  neg_ratio = 1,
  seed = NULL,
  method = c("history", "preferential")
)

Arguments

snapshots

A snapshot_sequence.

steps

Target snapshot indices.

neg_ratio

Negatives per positive.

seed

Optional integer seed.

method

"history" or "preferential".

Value

Named vector of mean ROC-AUC and average precision.
